title: Intent variants — price — Uzbek Latin
content: Customer expressions: narx, narxi, narxchi, narxn bern, narx necpul, nechpul, qanaqa narx, qanchadan, narxi qancha hozir. Intent: PRICE. These phrases contain no current business fact. Ask for product/code if missing; use only current ACTIVE structured price if product is known.

title: Intent variants — stock — Uzbek Latin
content: Customer expressions: bormi, qoldimi, tayyori bormi, hozir skladda bormi, ozroq bo‘lsa ham yo‘qmi. Intent: STOCK. Use structured inventory only. If inventory is UNKNOWN, never say available.

title: Intent variants — price and stock — Uzbek Cyrillic
content: Мижоз иборалари: нархи қанча, қанчадан, неч пул, борми, қолдими, тайёри борми, ҳозир складда борми. Intentlar: PRICE ва STOCK. Жавоб ўзбек кириллида бўлади. Нарх ва қолдиқ фақат structured data орқали тасдиқланади.

title: Intent variants — price and stock — Russian
content: Фразы клиента: какая цена, сколько стоит, почём, есть в наличии, осталось, есть на складе. Intent: PRICE или STOCK. Отвечать по-русски. Использовать только актуальную подтверждённую цену и structured inventory.

title: Textile customer vocabulary — packaging and orders
content: Synonyms: babina/bobina = bobbin; katta/kotta babina = large bobbin; karobka/karopka = box or package; sklad = warehouse; zakaz = order; spes/spec/spets = specification or order document depending on context; obrazets/obrazes = sample; ostatka = remaining stock.

title: Textile customer vocabulary — payment and logistics
content: Synonyms: perechesleniya = bank transfer; naxd/nal = cash; NDS = VAT/QQS; faktura = invoice; dovernost = power of attorney; shofyor/shafyor = driver; moshina/mashina/taksi = pickup or logistics; axrana/oxrana = security post; lokatsiya = location.

title: Textile customer vocabulary — quality, color and material
content: Synonyms: brak = defective product; vozvrat = return; tuklik = fuzziness/quality complaint; panton/pantone = Pantone color standard; sostav = composition; seriy = grey; seryo = raw material. Do not confuse seriy with seryo.

title: Protected product tokens
content: Preserve these product/spec tokens exactly: 30/70, 20/70, 15/55, 15/75, 20/75, 75D/36, 70D/2, 40D/2, 2070K, 3070K. Do not invent or expand their technical meaning unless structured product data confirms it.

title: Intent variants — sample, catalog and specification
content: obrazets, obrazes, namuna, bir bobina ko‘rsak = SAMPLE; katalog, rasmni tashabering, ip rasmini yuboring = CATALOG_OR_MEDIA; spes, spec, spets, zakaz yozaman = SPECIFICATION_OR_ORDER_ACTION. Sample or catalog availability must be verified before promising it.

title: Intent variants — complaint and return
content: Customer expressions: sifati yaxshimi, tuklik qilyapti, brak, qaytarilgan ip, almashtirib berasizmi, o‘zingizga qaytaraman. Intent: COMPLAINT_OR_RETURN. Required flow: brief apology, request photo/video/sample, create high-priority manager or technologist handoff. Never promise replacement, refund or compensation without approval.

title: Intent variants — export and large order
content: Other-country destination, export price/documents, tonnage quantity, repeat order, ‘zakaz yozaman’, ‘bugun olamiz’ and vehicle pickup are strong purchase signals. Classify export and qualified large orders as HOT/high priority and create manager handoff after collecting only the missing essential details.

title: Safe dialog patterns — unknown business facts
content: If current price is missing: ‘Bu mahsulot bo‘yicha amaldagi narx tasdiqlanmagan. Qancha miqdor kerak edi?’ If stock is UNKNOWN: ‘Hozirgi qoldiq tasdiqlanmagan. Qancha miqdor kerak edi?’ Never use historical Telegram values. Never say ‘tekshiraman’ unless a real check or handoff was successfully started.

title: Safe dialog patterns — Uzbek Cyrillic
content: Мижоз: ‘30/70 оқдан борми?’ Агар inventory UNKNOWN бўлса: ‘Ҳозирги қолдиқ тасдиқланмаган. Қанча миқдор керак эди?’ Мижоз кириллда ёзса, жавоб ўзбек кириллида берилади ва product token ўзгармайди.

title: Safe dialog patterns — Russian
content: Клиент: ‘Есть 30/70 белый?’ Если inventory UNKNOWN: ‘Актуальный остаток пока не подтверждён. Какое количество вам нужно?’ Сохранять product token без изменений и отвечать по-русски.
